review_text: Bumped into this cute Japanese-themed café in the south! They have the cutest interior — I love how cozy and aesthetically clean the space is. They even have a resident cat! We ordered the oat matcha (7/10 for me) and the mocha brew (6/10). We also enjoyed their fish pancake!
The coffee has greater character. Ordered the caramel latte and had almond milk option.
A little bit overpriced, you're paying for the atmosphere and vibe,the coffee is okay,but not worth the money, my suggestion is to find other options
